about: The Workbench icons of the vitetris drawer: python3 AMICRADLE/scripts/ports/port_icons.py amiga/icons/icons.json --out amiga/icons (DalsinAI/amicradle). art/vitetris.png is three falling blocks drawn for this port (BSD 2-clause, like vitetris). vitetris-drawer.info is the drawer's own icon, put beside the drawer as vitetris.info; it has its own name here so as not to meet the program's vitetris.info. ReadMe.info is also copied for Licence.txt and vitetris.txt.
